svg.title: Tam-AI-Ti, a te reo Māori AI coach for financial wellbeing, built on the Māori holistic-health model Te Whare Tapa Whā. Five parts of the product at work: a daily whakataukī and check-in, the maramataka calendar, a goal's action plan, a hauora journal filled in by voice, and whānau support with permissions the user sets; the interface is recreated in code, and the demo account and figures are illustrative.
